name: Otouto: Nichijoukei
source:
Mom and Dad have gone on a one-night, two-day trip!
I’m the only one who can calm my quarrelsome little brothers!
It’s an ordinary day, but with a slightly unusual morning—will I be able to get through it safely…?
translation:
爸爸妈妈去进行为期两天一夜的旅行了！
只有我能让吵闹的弟弟们安静下来！
这是平凡的一天，却从有些不寻常的早晨开始——我能平安度过吗……？
